text: The engineered RNA molecule that fuses crRNA and tracrRNA into a single ~100-nt transcript guiding Cas9 to its target is called the ___.
explanation: This fusion molecule is the single guide RNA (sgRNA), combining the crRNA (which provides target specificity via its 20-nt spacer) and the tracrRNA (needed for Cas9 scaffold binding) into one convenient engineered transcript. This simplifies guide design and delivery compared to the native bacterial dual-RNA (crRNA + tracrRNA) system.
